column2: The Hydra's whereabouts have been narrowed down. To lure it out, a new Mass Pheromone Emitter will be constructed in the sector. Unfortunately, a swarm of Acid Grenadiers downed the transport dropships, scattering the machine's modules across Bug territory. To keep the program on track, the lost cargo must be retrieved immediately.
